scope: Project-owned ARMv6-M binary64 sin/cos/tan and exact int32/uint32-to-double. Production RP2040 ELF compared with 1ca2db58e and a separate Qfplib-M0-full ELF by actual executed ARM instruction count. Cortex-M4 unchanged.

integer_conversion.algorithm: A Thumb-1 leaf handles sign/zero, normalizes the exact 32-bit magnitude in 16/8/4/2/1-bit chunks and splits it into binary64. Signed and unsigned entries share the normalizer. All int32/uint32 values are exactly representable.
integer_conversion.registers: R0-R3 only, no stack, no SIO or compiler helper calls.

trig.algorithm: For reduced |r| >= 1/64, select j=round(|r|*1024), reconstruct sin/cos from certified Q62 sin(j/1024), cos(j/1024) and cubic/quartic small-residual corrections. tan shares both reconstructions. Exact rounded Q62 products and a Thumb-1 nearest-even pack retain guard bits. Small reduced inputs retain relative normalized polynomials with four coefficients; inputs below 2^-27 retain the original tiny-input handling.
trig.medium_reduction: For pi/4 < |x| < 2^20, use pi/2 truncated to Q95. Two wide products plus one low product compute x-n*pi/2 modulo 96 bits. The constant error is less than n low-word units. A low word farther than n from both boundaries certifies Q62 nearest rounding; uncertain cases recompute using Q191. Small residuals use a signed primary/tail pair, with shared fdlibm refinement for more than 100 leading zero bits. Huge inputs keep the original full reducer.
trig.index_bound: For |x|<2^20, the Q32 quadrant estimate underestimates x*2/pi by less than (1+2/pi)*2^-12 < 0.0004. Thus the largest reduced magnitude is below pi/4+0.0004*pi/2 < 0.786027 and the nearest j/1024 index is at most 805.
trig.precision: The existing 4-ULP contract is preserved. Observed maximum over 223131 inputs per function: sin/cos 1 ULP, tan 2 ULP. This is qualification evidence, not an exhaustive proof of correctly rounded transcendental functions.

constant_proof.proof: Exact Fraction alternating-series lower/upper bounds certify every Q62 nearest rounding, Q191 pi/2 truncation, and Q32 reciprocal truncation.

trig.compile_option: New C++ kernels use function-local GCC optimize(Os) to limit register spills; other arithmetic compilation options are unchanged.

implementation.license: Independently derived project code and generated constants. No Qfplib GPL source or data copied into the firmware.

production_profile.abi: Every call checks R4-R11/SP and bounded stack/SIO writes.
production_profile.oracle: Independent Decimal Machin pi (430 digits), 100/400-digit reduction and Taylor sin/cos; tan is the high-precision quotient. Integer products/conversions use exact Python integers.
production_profile.qfplib_documented_trig_domain: README.md: double-precision trigonometric functions require -1024 <= x <= 1024. Wider streams are diagnostics only and excluded from the speed gate.
production_profile.note: Executed ARM instruction counts, not RP2040 cycles or timings. Qfplib may have substantially larger trig ULP error; counts do not imply equal accuracy.

arm_runtime.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack and SIO divider only
arm_runtime.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

portable_runtime.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack only
portable_runtime.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

production_math.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack and SIO divider only
production_math.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

addition_bytes_preserved.scope: Read-only byte comparison: subtraction entry and all addition fast paths in the production ELF exactly match the independently tested ARM binary. No ELF execution or external fallback relocation check is performed.

manifest.board: ClockworkPi PicoCalc + Raspberry Pi Pico H

float_usage.purpose: APP conversion service and the existing math self-test; no resident float arithmetic.

qfplib.documented_domain: The pinned README restricts double trigonometry to [-1024,+1024]. All speed claims use this domain; the wider medium stream is diagnostic only.
qfplib.accuracy: ULP error is independently recorded. Near multiples of pi/2 Qfplib can have much larger errors; instruction comparisons do not assume equal accuracy.
qfplib.scope: Separate external ELF, never linked into production.

limits: Instruction counts are not RP2040 cycles or microseconds; hardware timings remain pending. The device is disconnected and the user authorized continuing without it.
All 15 comparable stream means are below Qfplib; there is no claim of a universal per-input instruction ordering.
Accuracy qualification is directed/random and does not exhaust the entire binary64 domain. The mathematical constant roundings are certified by exact rational inequalities.
The full firmware includes RP2040 SIO divider support. The portable runtime is qualified separately for correctness; its tan instruction counts are not the RP2040 comparison.
SDK ROM CLZ/memory intrinsics are functionally modeled, with their internal instruction costs excluded by the common harness.
Flash increased by 14728 bytes, including a 12896-byte sin/cos table. Static RAM is unchanged.
